changes.action: Add one explicit harness switch branch calling cliHarness(args[1:]); optional stderr-only help hint after existing cliHelpSurface. Preserve old task/run/goal/cancel/interactive paths and old Mu help JSON.

Portable thin command parser and authenticated Host V1 transport; namespace help/caps/task submit/list/get/events/cancel, fixed relative routes, closed typed request/response checks, no child process, DB, scheduler, worker or model configuration.

Direct in-process command runner with synthetic stdin/stdout/stderr, fresh discovery/session fixtures and fake native/HTTP dependencies; actual route/JSON/lost-ACK/CAS/large-int assertions. No executable/model/real authentication file or old DB access.

source_facts.fact: Top-level task already routes legacy taskDispatch; a new harness namespace avoids changing its local checker/repair behavior.

resolveCLIHostDiscovery reuses explicit discovery path, legacy cwd discovery, then shared per-user locator. Validates loopback URL and shared locator exact identity/data-root/canonical paths. A discovery is a non-secret hint, not a credential.

cliHostInstanceID rechecks current discovery. cliNativeRequest uses the existing OS-protected named pipe, validates reply kind. cliSessionCredential reads the current bounded regular session handoff and expiry. cliInitCredential first honors RESEARCHOS_CLI_CREDENTIAL, so new Harness must not call that wrapper or reuse its env override.

NATIVE_USER_BOOTSTRAP_RESULT returns authenticated_principal_ref, client_id, host_instance_id, protocol_version and credential_exposed_to_renderer=false. Token is excluded from the native reply and handed off via the existing private session file.
hostGet is an unauthenticated health GET with a 4096-byte read and default redirect behavior. It is not sufficient for V1 tasks.

v2CallTransportDetailed is fixed to /v2/command, V2 envelopes and session writer semantics. New Harness transport must reuse the Host, not fake a V2 session or put native Harness into model_config_ref.
readCLIPrompt provides bounded single-read UTF-8/blank validation (65536 bytes and 16384 Unicode characters). Reuse it for --prompt-stdin; also reject NUL before request.

commands.behavior: JSONL usage and supported readonly surface; no discovery, credentials, metadata probes or model execution.
Print exact Host capabilities/verification. Does not run vendor help/login/model itself or promote UNVERIFIED to ready.

commands.command: researchos harness task submit --project P --workspace-ref W --request-id K --prompt-stdin
commands.behavior: Require explicit stable K; ACK is QUEUED with run null. Print transport acknowledgement separately from execution status; do not wait/follow or start any local worker in this first slice.

commands.command: researchos harness task list --project P [--request-id K] [--cursor C] [--limit N]
commands.behavior: Authoritative Core lookup/history across restarts. request_id filter refers to original submit IDs.

commands.command: researchos harness task get --project P --task T
commands.behavior: Read original Task/Run snapshot, including UNKNOWN. Does not acquire a writer or rerun work.

commands.command: researchos harness task events --project P --task T [--cursor C] [--limit N]
commands.behavior: One bounded authoritative page, including reset/snapshot/end semantics. Caller uses next_cursor for subsequent reads; no SSE or fake token deltas.

commands.command: researchos harness task cancel --project P --task T --request-id CK --expected-task-revision R --expect-no-run
commands.behavior: Explicit queued CAS. Claim race returns STATE_CONFLICT; never fetch newer state and silently cancel it.

commands.command: researchos harness task cancel --project P --task T --request-id CK --expected-task-revision R --expected-run-id RUN --expected-epoch E
commands.behavior: Exact current Run/epoch/revision CAS; acknowledgement remains CANCEL_REQUESTED until Core reports actual stopped cleanup. Does not issue local process kill.

authentication_and_transport: No --url/--token/--credential/--exe/--args/--backend/provider/model/session flags and no corresponding environment credential override are accepted by the new namespace.

Reuse resolveCLIHostDiscovery and cliHostInstanceID; current loopback Host, registered data root and native Host identity are rechecked before a request. Do not claim protection against a malicious process of the same OS user beyond existing Host boundary.

Obtain credentials only from existing cliSessionCredential; if absent/expired, use current Native USER_BOOTSTRAP request/validated host ID and client ID, then reread current session handoff. Do not call cliInitCredential because it trusts RESEARCHOS_CLI_CREDENTIAL.

Native bootstrap reply fields must match the expected client/Host and protocol with credential_exposed_to_renderer=false. Never print native payloads, session bytes, bearer values or credential-bearing diagnostics.

Use a private new fixed-relative-path HTTP helper: bearer header from this Host only, JSON body, 8-second request budget, redirects refused, Proxy nil, bounded complete UTF-8 JSON reply and closed DTO validation. No generic absolute URL argument.
Suppress HTTP automatic POST replay: no Idempotency-Key replay header, req.GetBody=nil, and no reused keepalive connection. Stable request_id is in the body and enforced by Core.

Retain existing stdout JSONL/stderr diagnostic and exit-code conventions. Queued/lookup ACK is explicitly not execution completion. UNKNOWN/error exits nonzero with stable request/task identifiers, not a synthetic completed result.
idempotency_and_unknown: No new CLI pending journal. Submit and cancel require explicit --request-id; it is validated before reading Host state and never regenerated.
Once mutation Do has begun, transport timeout/disconnect, incomplete body or invalid ACK is conservatively UNKNOWN. Do not automatically POST again, change key, or retry after credential renewal.

For submit lost ACK, perform at most one GET tasks lookup using the same project_id/request_id. FOUND is validated against original harness/workspace/scope/prompt and reports the authoritative task; NOT_FOUND is not evidence that the original request was unused and remains UNKNOWN.

For cancel lost ACK, request_id lookup cannot be reused: the public list lookup is for submits only. Only GET exact task/events may show observed cancellation state. Preserve mutation outcome UNKNOWN; never treat NOT_FOUND in submit history as unused cancel.
409 STATE_CONFLICT includes current snapshot/fence only for user inspection. Never automatically adopt newer revision/Run/epoch and repeat a cancel.
Ctrl-C on a GET only interrupts reading. Ctrl-C after a POST may have reached Host and must preserve UNKNOWN plus identifiers; it is not an automatic cancellation command.
wire_validation: Reuse domain.HarnessDecimal for decimal strings in canonical 0..MaxInt64 form, positive for revisions/epochs. No float64 conversion, no JSON number epochs/sequence/cursors, no leading plus/zero aliases; preserve values above 2^53 exactly.

Closed bounded request flags and response envelope api_version=harness.v1; reject duplicate/unknown fields, malformed UTF-8, incorrect project/task/request refs or unexpected statuses before claiming success.
workspace_ref is the exact opaque authorized_workspace_ref string; never a filesystem path or serialized VersionRef.

Queued SubmitData requires run=null. Task/Run fields may later carry real decimal-string epochs. Events validate task refs, increasing sequences, next_cursor, reset/snapshot/end relationship; no mutation follows cursor reset.
Only supported readonly operations are exposed. Resume/write/pause/tool-approval/diff/artifact capabilities remain false/unsupported as reported by Host.
tests: No Host/native/HTTP call for missing/duplicate/unsupported flags, blank/invalid UTF-8/oversize/NUL stdin or missing request ID.
Exact six method/path/body shapes and opaque workspace handling; no generated session/model/provider fields.
Fake Native bootstrap produces only matching Host/client/protocol and current handoff; explicit env token ignored; fake external URL/redirect never receives bearer.
Lost submit ACK: server records first POST, connection fails, exactly one GET lookup, zero second POST; FOUND/reply mismatch/NOT_FOUND remain truthful.
Lost cancel ACK: only GET task/events, never submit-ID lookup or automatic POST.
Queued versus active cancel exact nullable pair; stale revision/epoch response does not trigger another mutation.
Epoch/revision/cursor=9007199254740993 string retained; numeric, overflow, aliases and mismatched event scopes rejected.
Queued and CANCEL_REQUESTED are not reported as execution completed; terminal/error/reset pages retain authoritative Host fields.
Necessary existing pure CLI compatibility selectors: old version/help/task/run dispatch are unchanged; no old native/model integration tests or real processes under this scope.

implementation_boundary.resources_required: Root registers three exact paths in a new isolated worktree from the integrated base; locked offline Go cache and C-only fake HTTP/native/IO fixtures are sufficient.
